items.title: Relaticle
items.name: Relaticle
items.summary: Open-source CRM with approval-gated AI writes
items.description: Most CRMs bolt AI on. Relaticle is built agent-first: any MCP client gets 37 first-party tools over OAuth, with workspace custom fields in each agent's schema automatically. The in-app assistant is stricter: every write is a proposal showing the exact change, approved record by record. Self-host everything under AGPL, including local inference with Ollama. Free forever self-hosted; Cloud is flat per-workspace pricing, not per-seat.
top_comments: Hi Product Hunt, Manuk here. I've been building Relaticle for about two years, mostly solo. It started as a conventional open-source CRM. Then I added agents and hit a question I couldn't dodge: how much authority should each kind of client get? Read-only access was too limited to be useful. Silent writes into customer data felt wrong. I ended up with two trust levels. External MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, anything that speaks MCP) authenticate over OAuth and write directly through 37 tools, the same way an API client would. The in-app assistant works next to human users, so every write it wants becomes a proposal that shows the exact change and waits for approval. Batches are reviewed record by record: you approve or skip each one, and whatever you approved is kept. The chat client itself was rebuilt after failures I hit in real use. A rate-limited retry could delete a conversation turn. A stale stream handler could write a draft into the wrong conversation. Drafts now survive reloads, failed sends stay visible, and answers link back to the records they mention. Everything self-hosts under AGPL, including model inference with Ollama. Each workspace defines its own custom fields, and they show up in the agents' schemas automatically. One question I'm still chewing on and would genuinely like opinions on: should an in-app assistant ever get policy-based auto-approval, or should every write stay explicit?
Approval gated writes is the piece I keep rewriting in my own tooling. Where did you land on the granularity, one approval per write or one per session?

Flat per-workspace pricing on the cloud tier is the right call for a CRM: per-seat is how you get three people sharing one login.

How do you stop the flat price from being a bad deal for a solo founder and a steal for a 30-person team? Usage caps, or you just accept the spread?
items.author: Manuk Minasyan
items.why: Product Hunt 当前获得 165 票、37 条评论；仍处在近期新品验证窗口；产品形态已经比较完整
items.mechanism: 可迁移的机制在于把通用模型能力封装进具体产品形态，让用户按任务而不是按模型来消费能力。
items.routing_reason: Relaticle is a general-purpose open-source CRM with an agent-first architecture and approval-gated AI writes. It does not specifically target any vertical interest point's core task such as legal workflows, supply chain analysis, education, email automation, etc. It is a horizontal CRM platform, not a specialized solution for a listed domain.
items.reuse_direction: 把AI生成的业务数据先放进待审批队列，经人确认后才正式落库，适合所有需要AI辅助录入但必须有人负责的产品。

idea_items.title: 简历优化助手
idea_items.need_line: 求职者改简历时真正卡住的是具体取舍——简历时间线要不要拉长、空窗期怎么表述才不被筛掉，缺的并不是泛泛的文字润色。
idea_items.status_line: 现在多靠知乎问答求经验判断，再翻“从简历到面试需要哪些工具”这类清单，把简历、投递、面试各环节的工具自行拼成一条流程。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把时间线、空窗期这类需要判断的简历取舍与后续面试准备串成可回溯的一条链路，而不是只做单点文字润色。

idea_items.title: 邮件自动化工具
idea_items.need_line: 外贸销售在客户连续不回复时，需要判断隔多久、挑哪个客户、用什么内容再发一封跟进邮件，而写和回这类邮件目前全靠人工完成。
idea_items.status_line: 现状是社区侧主要用工具清单和经验贴回应跟进难题，而开源侧已把邮件做成 agent 可读写、可检索的异步收件箱与线程，讨论正从模板清单转向把邮件流当作可程序化调度的消息层。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把「这个客户多久没回、下一封该发什么」沉淀为邮件线程级的跟进状态与触发条件，让 agent 依据线程历史决定是否再次触达，而不是再做通用模板或群发工具。

idea_items.title: 供应链仓储 AI 应用
idea_items.need_line: 用户需要能直接支撑供应链补货分析的工具，而不是 SWOT、波士顿矩阵这类偏战略评估的通用框架。
idea_items.status_line: 知乎相关热门内容多为“100个管理工具详解”式合集，以访谈、流程审计和矩阵分类为主线，强调人工交叉验证与跨职能协作，缺少补货场景的具体操作方案。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的具体产品化方向是：让战略分析模型接入内外部数据，自动识别业务组合并生成补货等场景的行动建议，减少人工访谈与误判。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 做外贸的销售在客户连续不回复时，需要判断该隔多久、对哪个客户、用什么内容再发一封跟进邮件，而写和回这类邮件目前全靠人手工完成

items.paragraph: 现状是 zhihu 侧用「工具清单＋经验贴」回应跟进难题，GitHub 侧则已经出现把邮件做成 agent 可读写、可检索的异步收件箱与线程（mcp_agent_mail 的 identities/inboxes/threads、portal 内嵌 mail），讨论正从「模板和清单」移向把邮件流当作可程序化调度的消息层。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把「这个客户多久没回、下一封该发什么」沉淀成邮件线程级的跟进状态与触发条件，让 agent 能基于线程历史决定是否再触达，而不是再做一套通用模板或群发工具。

vendor_news_items.title: Mistral SDK python - v2.10.0 - 2026-09-09 13:27:17 发布
vendor_news_items.raw_summary: # Generated by Speakeasy CLI ## 2026-09-09 10:25:27 ### API changes Removed (19): - campaigns.create - campaigns.delete - campaigns.fetch - campaigns.fetch_status - campaigns.list - campaigns.list_events - chatcompletionevents.fetch - chatcompletionevents.fetch_similar_events - chatcompletionevents.judge - chatcompletionevents.search - chatcompletionevents.search_ids - connectors.create_or_update_organization_credentials - connectors.create_or_update_user_credentials - connectors.create_or_update_workspace_credentials - datasets.import_from_campaign - datasets.import_from_explorer - fields.fetch_option_counts - fields.fetch_options - fields.list Added (17): - connectors.create_credentials - connectors.share_to_organization - connectors.unshare_from_organization - connectors.update_credentials - evaluations.create_pipeline_config - evaluations.delete_pipeline_config - evaluations.get_pipeline_config - evaluations.list_pipeline_configs - evaluations.update_pipeline_config - serviceaccounts.create - serviceaccounts.delete - serviceaccounts.get - serviceaccounts.list - serviceaccounts.list_assignable_roles - serviceaccounts.list_roles - serviceaccounts.set_roles - serviceaccounts.update ### Breaking changes Connectors - `connectors.create` now takes a single request object, and `connectors.update` a `request_body`. The named arguments (`name`, `description`, `server`, `title`, ...) are no longer accepted. - `Connector` is now a union of `HTTPConnector` and `MCPConnector`, discriminated on `protocol`. Fields that were flat on `Connector` now live on the variant. - `protocol` is required on the create payload. In TypeScript it no longer defaults to `"mcp"`, so it must be passed explicitly. Python still defaults it. Other models - `ExtendedOAuthServerMetadata.authorization_endpoint` is now optional. - `UsageInfoDollarDefs.service_tier` has been removed. - Three fields on `DeploymentWorkerSpecResponse` are now required. ### Fixed - Transcription segment `start` and `end` are now nullable. The API can return null for these, so diarized transcriptions previously failed to parse. ### Changes Based on: - OpenAPI Doc - Speakeasy CLI 1.796.1 (2.933.0) https://github.com/speakeasy-api/speakeasy ### Generated - [python v2.10.0] . ### Releases - [PyPI v2.10.0] https://pypi.org/project/mistralai/2.10.0 - . Publishing Completed

interest_sections.title: 简历优化助手
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，围绕简历优化，讨论集中在时间线表述这类判断性难题和简历到面试的工具串联，而非纯粹的措辞美化。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者改简历时真正卡住的是具体取舍——简历时间要不要拉长、空窗期怎么表述才不被筛掉，而不是缺一个泛泛的润色功能

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 大家现在靠知乎问答求经验判断，再翻“从简历到面试需要哪些工具”这类清单，把简历、投递、面试几个环节的工具自行拼成一条流程。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把时间线、空窗期这类需要判断的简历取舍，与后续面试准备串成可回溯的一条链路，而不是只做单点文字润色。

interest_sections.title: 邮件自动化工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub：中文侧只有外贸跟进的提问标题和一篇与「回邮件」主题错位的财务自动化正文，只能确认需求存在而看不到具体做法，GitHub 侧却已把邮件当作 agent 间可读写的异步收件箱与线程来建设，需求与解法之间尚未接上。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 做外贸的销售在客户连续不回复时，需要判断该隔多久、对哪个客户、用什么内容再发一封跟进邮件，而写和回这类邮件目前全靠人手工完成

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是 zhihu 侧用「工具清单＋经验贴」回应跟进难题，GitHub 侧则已经出现把邮件做成 agent 可读写、可检索的异步收件箱与线程（mcp_agent_mail 的 identities/inboxes/threads、portal 内嵌 mail），讨论正从「模板和清单」移向把邮件流当作可程序化调度的消息层。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把「这个客户多久没回、下一封该发什么」沉淀成邮件线程级的跟进状态与触发条件，让 agent 能基于线程历史决定是否再触达，而不是再做一套通用模板或群发工具。
